title.en: Median yearly salary reported by developers using each language, US dollars

desc.en: Horizontal bars: Erlang 100,636, Ruby 90,221, Go 76,433, Rust 76,292, Python 67,723, C# 66,066, TypeScript 65,907, JavaScript 63,694, Java 61,714, PHP 49,586

source.en: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2024, "Top paying technologies", programming languages, median in US dollars. The 2025 edition did not publish this table.
source.fr: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2024, « Top paying technologies », langages, médiane en dollars. L'édition 2025 n'a pas publié ce tableau.

note.en: Self-reported, worldwide, not adjusted for country. PHP was the second-lowest of fifty languages listed.
note.fr: Auto-déclaré, mondial, non corrigé du pays. PHP était l'avant-dernier des cinquante langages listés.
